summary_notes: This sheet is intentionally compact — rows are claims not finalized allocations. For any 'Approved' row infra-ops will convert claim -> allocation and create an allocation ticket (OPS). 'Pending' rows require approver action or clarifying info. 'Denied' rows should include reason and suggested mitigation. Avoid duplicate claims: check region and overlap windows before approving.
